title: ORAV OTT JA REBANE REIN TEEVAD LIIVALINNA

characters.name: ORAV OTT
characters.description: Väike hall orav, koheva sabaga. Kannab sinist T-särki ja lühikesi pükse. Suured rohelised silmad, uudishimulik näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: REBANE REIN
characters.description: Väike oranž rebane, valge kõhuga. Kannab kollast T-särki ja lühikesi pükse. Terased silmad, rõõmus näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Päikeseline rand
locations.description: Sunny sandy beach. Golden sand covers the ground. Calm blue ocean in the distance. A few scattered seashells on the sand. Bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds. Warm sunlight. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Orav Ott, wearing a blue t-shirt and shorts, and Rebane Rein, wearing a yellow t-shirt and shorts, are standing on a sunny sandy beach. They are looking at the calm blue ocean in the distance, with bright and curious expressions. Scattered seashells are visible on the sand. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Rebane Rein are standing on a sunny sandy beach, looking at each other with bright, excited, and thoughtful expressions. Ott points playfully towards the sand with one paw. Scattered seashells are visible on the sand. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Rebane Rein are kneeling on the sunny sandy beach. Ott is using a small red shovel to gather golden sand into a small blue bucket. Rein is using his paws to push sand towards the bucket. They both look focused and happy. Scattered seashells are visible on the sand. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Rebane Rein are working together on a sunny sandy beach. Ott is carefully piling sand from a blue bucket to create a growing sand mound. Rein is patting the sides of the sand mound with his paws. A small blue bucket and a red shovel are next to them. Scattered seashells are visible on the sand. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Rebane Rein are focused on shaping their sand creation on a sunny sandy beach. Ott is gently smoothing the sides of a large sand mound with his paws. Rein is carefully pressing down the top of the sand mound. They both look concentrated. A small blue bucket and a red shovel are nearby. Scattered seashells are visible on the sand. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Rebane Rein are actively building on their sand creation on a sunny sandy beach. Ott is carefully carving out a small turret on the side of a tall sandcastle structure. Rein is adding a small block of sand to form a wall. The sandcastle is starting to take shape. A small blue bucket and a red shovel are next to them. Scattered seashells are visible on the sand. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Rebane Rein are standing proudly next to their tall, impressive sandcastle on a sunny sandy beach. The sandcastle has several turrets and walls. They look at the sandcastle with admiration and smiles. A small blue bucket and a red shovel are resting nearby. Scattered seashells are visible on the sand. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Rebane Rein are decorating their completed sandcastle on a sunny sandy beach. Ott is carefully placing a small, colorful seashell on top of one of the sandcastle's turrets. Rein is arranging a few small pebbles around the base of the sandcastle. They both look joyful and focused on the details. Scattered seashells are visible on the sand. Cartoon style.

A beautifully decorated sandcastle stands tall on a sunny sandy beach. Small, colorful seashells and pebbles adorn its turrets and walls. Orav Ott and Rebane Rein are standing a little back, admiring their creation with big smiles and satisfaction. The ocean and blue sky are in the background. Scattered seashells are visible on the sand. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Rebane Rein are sitting happily next to their magnificent, decorated sandcastle on a sunny sandy beach. They are smiling and high-fiving each other with joyful expressions, proud of their work. The ocean and blue sky are in the background. Scattered seashells are visible on the sand. Cartoon style.
